name: histogramdd_from_bin_tensors
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::_histogramdd_from_bin_tensors(Tensor self, Tensor[] bins, *, Tensor? weight=None, bool density=False) -> Tensor. Computes a histogram from explicit per-dimension edge tensors without mutating or aliasing inputs. Tests preserve base and autogenerated out coverage, uniform and nonuniform edges, weights, density, high-dimensional and many-bin inputs, outliers and boundaries, precision, empty and zero-total density cases, weight errors, and out identity/storage/resize/dtype/noncontiguous behavior.
